description: Fires most strongly right after the very first move of the game when the opponent opened on the right edge (column 6, strongest) or column 5, and weakly for a column-0 opening; centre/other openings stay just below threshold. The remaining firing (about half) is scattered over mid- and late-game positions near threshold with no clean board pattern (slightly more when the last move was in column 0, 3 or 6).
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes no move probability (tested 3 positions).
notes: Layer-0 unit with tiny activations (dev max 0.009). Score 1 (ply-1 opening in 0/5/6): F1 0.593, P 1.0, R 0.42, sim share 4.18. Score 2 adding centre-column/late-game rules: F1 0.226, dropped. Mid-game firing looks like a diffuse additive mix of last-move token and earlier move tokens (own stones in col 3 raise it); possibly a random-direction-like mixture. No steering effect. Synthesis cannot exceed dev max. Synthesis revised after orchestrator audit: two earlier sequences completed a vertical four in column 3 on move 7 (game over); replaced with sequences where no move completes a four (synth 0.006 each).
